spans.s:
mf. (-रुः-रुः)
1 A cucumber, (Cumumis utilatissimus, Rox.)
2 Another kind, (Cucumis colocynthis.)
E.
इरु a seed, and आरु what goes to or gets, from ऋ and उण् affix, or आलु, र becoming ल; also written इर्व्वालु, ईर्व्वारु, उर्व्वारु, &c.

m. (-रुः)
A cucumber, (Cucumis utilatissimus); also ईर्व्वालु and इर्व्वारु, &c.

f. (-का)
A kind of melon; commonly Sphuti or Sphut, (Cucumis momordica.)
E.
इर्व्वारु and शुक्तिका an oyster-shaped cucumber.
